title: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
body: The OlmoEarth platform has been launched to enable geospatial inference and environmental monitoring at a planetary scale. Built on open geospatial models, the platform processes satellite imagery, climate data, and terrain maps to analyze global changes in forest cover, agriculture, and urban expansion. The project aims to provide researchers and policymakers with transparent, actionable environmental insights. By utilizing open-source machine learning models, OlmoEarth makes planetary-scale data analysis highly accessible to underfunded organizations and academic groups. This represents a major contribution to public environmental research.
